# WanaKana

`wanakana.min.js` is the unmodified browser bundle of WanaKana 5.3.1,
vendored so romaji conversion requires no runtime CDN request.

- Project: https://github.com/WaniKani/WanaKana
- Bundle: https://unpkg.com/wanakana@5.3.1/wanakana.min.js
- License: MIT; see `wanakana.LICENSE` (from the same published package).

KotoDict converts Latin runs only, preserving Japanese text and punctuation.
Pattern search retains `-` as its existing single-kana wildcard.
